expect: ripgrep already has --no-messages, which suppresses these errors; the new flag duplicates it
base64 flags are out of scope for ripgrep; a wrapper script should do this
quote: This isn't a good fit for ripgrep. You should have a wrapper script do this for you.

expect: the edit replaces a valid pattern with an invalid one: `{end-half}\b` isn't a valid pattern, so the doc change is wrong
quote: `{end-half}\b` isn't a valid pattern. Why would you change a valid pattern to an invalid one?

expect: no demonstrated need: no test or benchmark shows nondeterministic output or a speedup, so the change to the status quo isn't justified
quote: I'd rather bias toward the status quo rather than changing something without a clear need.

expect: new syntax must meet the popularity criteria in doc/assets.md, and the PR doesn't show it does
quote: Does this syntax fulfil the popularity requirement? See doc/assets.md#criteria-for-inclusion-of-new-syntaxes.

expect: treating mintty/MSYS2 as always interactive breaks piped output: bat would add colors and decorations when stdout is a pipe
quote: Doesn't this mean that when using mintty style terminals, it will always be treated as interactive mode? ... What if the user has aliased `cat` and is piping to another program?

expect: paging for --list-themes was added on purpose recently; force-disabling it reverses a deliberate choice
quote: paging was deliberately introduced recently ... I don't think we want to force disable paging when list themes, having just recently implemented it.

expect: the maintainer doesn't want more types handled by the JSON provider, and a different error for invalid data isn't a bug worth catching; also against the project's LLM/AI policy
quote: I do not want to add more types to this. I do not care that the error on invalid data is different for some data, it's invalid regardless and would be fixed not caught.

expect: pushing and popping the app/request context on every loop iteration is extremely inefficient (and the PR is AI-generated, against policy)
quote: Besides being AI generated, which is against our policy, this introduces extreme inefficiency due to pushing and popping the context on every loop.

expect: the hook isn't needed: users can already override make_response or return json.response directly
quote: You can override make_response already, or return json.response directly.

expect: the docs shouldn't advertise a demo the core team doesn't maintain
quote: I'd rather not advertise demos not maintained by the core team.

expect: no clear focus: many small opinionated stylistic changes bundled under a performance claim (which doesn't hold under the mypyc build)
quote: This PR doesn't have a clear focus and makes many opinionated small stylistic changes.
